prompt_text: What is the best tool for an Airbnb host to set nightly pricing and analyze a market before buying?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- For market analysis before buying: AirDNA (MarketMinder + Rentalizer) is the best single tool most investors use.
- For ongoing nightly pricing/revenue management once you list: PriceLabs, Beyond Pricing, or Wheelhouse — pick PriceLabs if you want the most customizable rules and analytics; Beyond Pricing if you want a very simple, automated setup; Wheelhouse if you want advanced revenue-management features.

Why those picks
- AirDNA: large STR dataset, neighborhood-level metrics (ADR, occupancy, RevPAR), seasonality, lead-time and booking window data, and a Rentalizer to estimate revenue for a specific address. Good for screening cities/neighborhoods and running pro forma assumptions.
- PriceLabs: excellent dynamic-pricing engine with highly customizable rules, minimum/maximum price control, length-of-stay and weekday controls, and good integration with most PMS/channel managers.
- Beyond Pricing: simpler, hands-off automation; good if you want set-and-forget revenue optimization.
- Wheelhouse: more advanced forecasting and risk-adjusted pricing options for power users.

How to use them together (recommended workflow)
1. Market screen with AirDNA: look at ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, seasonality, demand index, and comparable listings in the exact neighborhood. Use Rentalizer to estimate revenue for the address/type.
2. Verify manually: check real Airbnb listings, read local laws/regulations, assess comps, talk to local managers/hosts, and run a full expense pro forma (mortgage, taxes, cleaning, utilities, vacancy, management fee).
3. If you buy, connect your listing to a dynamic-pricing tool:
   - Use PriceLabs if you want granular control, custom rules and analytics.
   - Use Beyond Pricing to automate quickly with minimal setup.
   - Use Wheelhouse if you want advanced testing and segmentation.
4. Integrate with a PMS/channel manager (Hostaway, Guesty, Lodgify, etc.) if you have multiple listings; all the pricing tools integrate with major managers.
5. Continuously monitor bookings and adjust strategy; use the analytics dashboards on AirDNA/PriceLabs to validate assumptions.

Other tools to consider
- Mashvisor: useful for combined long-term and short-term investment analysis (property-level ROI).
- Transparent, AllTheRooms: alternative analytics providers (good in particular markets/regions).
- Airbnb Smart Pricing: free but less sophisticated — fine for a single listing or to compare.

Final recommendation
- If you can only pick one before buying: use AirDNA to evaluate markets and revenue potential.
- After purchase/listing: use PriceLabs for pricing + AirDNA to keep monitoring market trends.
